name: kfive-ai
description: Production-Level Offline Full Stack AI Assistant

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:code-runner
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling-security && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:code-runner && npm run test:notebook-runtime && npm run test:ollama-bridge
scripts.test:notebook-runtime: cd services/notebook-runtime && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:code-runner
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/dist backend/dist
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run install:all
